name: SEACR: log-det entropy + VICReg
tagline: VICReg's invariance/variance/covariance terms plus a negative log-determinant of each view's covariance to maximize Gaussian entropy.
formula:
$$\mathcal{L} = \lambda_{\mathrm{inv}}\,\mathrm{MSE}(z_1, z_2) + \lambda_{\det}\sum_{v}\bigl(-\tfrac{1}{D}\log\det(\Sigma_v + \varepsilon I)\bigr) + \lambda_{\mathrm{var}}\sum_v V(z_v) + \lambda_{\mathrm{cov}}\sum_v C(z_v)$$
$$V(z) = \frac{1}{D}\sum_d \max(0, 1-\sigma_d), \qquad C(z) = \frac{1}{D}\sum_{i\ne j}\Sigma_{ij}^2$$
diff_from_baseline: Augments the VICReg baseline with a log-det-of-covariance term that, unlike the hinged variance, retains nonzero gradient as eigenvalues shrink; uses a smaller 128-d projector so the covariance is full rank for slogdet.

name: FeatNCE: feature-axis InfoNCE
tagline: Standard MSE invariance plus an InfoNCE on the feature axis (column-normalized z), with all four pairings (within and across views) and a hinged variance term.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces VICReg's quadratic off-diagonal covariance penalty with a feature-axis InfoNCE that drives the embedding columns toward an orthogonal frame, including auto-similarity (z₁z₁ᵀ, z₂z₂ᵀ) terms — a shape used by neither VICReg nor Barlow Twins baselines.

name: Spectral cross-correlation regularizer
tagline: Pulls eigenvalues of the cross-view correlation Gram (CᵀC) toward 1 to keep many directions active across views, plus VICReg-style covariance and MSE invariance.
diff_from_baseline: Targets collapse as a low-rank failure: pushes singular values of the Barlow-style cross-correlation toward 1 explicitly via slogdet eigvalsh, instead of Barlow Twins' on/off-diagonal squared error; adds a VICReg-style decorrelation, but no variance hinge.

name: SCD: hyperspherical uniform decorrelation
tagline: Operates entirely on L2-normalized embeddings: cosine alignment for invariance, Gaussian-potential uniformity, and an off-diagonal correlation penalty.
formula:
$$\hat z_v = z_v/\|z_v\|,\qquad U(\hat z) = \frac{1}{N(N-1)}\sum_{i\ne j}\exp(-t\,\|\hat z_i - \hat z_j\|^2)$$
$$\mathcal{L} = \mathbb{E}[1 - \langle \hat z_1, \hat z_2\rangle] + \lambda_u\sum_v U(\hat z_v) + \lambda_d\sum_v \frac{1}{D(D-1)}\sum_{i\ne j}\rho_{ij}^2$$
diff_from_baseline: Replaces VICReg's MSE invariance + std-hinge with cosine invariance and a hyperspherical uniformity penalty (Wang & Isola style), then keeps a normalized off-diagonal-correlation decorrelation similar to Barlow Twins; never uses raw embeddings — always projects to the unit sphere.

name: VICReg + cosine uniformity (HUR)
tagline: Standard VICReg invariance/variance/covariance objective with an additional squared-cosine off-diagonal uniformity penalty on each view.
formula:
$$U(z) = \frac{1}{B(B-1)}\sum_{i\ne j} \langle \hat z_i, \hat z_j\rangle^2,\quad \hat z = z/\|z\|$$
$$\mathcal{L} = \lambda_i\mathrm{MSE}(z_1,z_2) + \lambda_v V + \lambda_c C + \lambda_u\,(U(z_1)+U(z_2))$$
diff_from_baseline: Adds a squared-cosine pairwise uniformity penalty on top of the VICReg baseline; conceptually similar to SCD/HUR uniformity but kept on raw (unnormalized only inside the new term) embeddings, while VICReg's variance/covariance terms stay intact.
